gloss: alcohol harassment; pressuring others to drink

definitions.gloss: alcohol harassment; coercing or pressuring someone to drink
definitions.explanation: Harassment through alcohol — forcibly offering drinks to someone who has declined, mocking non-drinkers, or pressuring someone to keep drinking until ill. Abbreviated from アルコールハラスメント. Common in discussions of Japanese workplace drinking culture.

examples.japanese: アルハラにならないよう{気|き}をつける。
examples.english: To be careful not to engage in alcohol harassment.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}めない{人|ひと}に{無理|むり}に{飲|の}ませるのはアルハラだ。
examples.english: Forcing drinks on someone who can't drink is alcohol harassment.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{若者|わかもの}は{飲|の}み{会|かい}のアルハラに{敏感|びんかん}で、{強制参加|きょうせいさんか}を{嫌|きら}う{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: Young people these days are sensitive to alcohol harassment at work parties and tend to dislike being forced to attend.

notes:
Abbreviation of アルコールハラスメント (alcohol harassment). Particularly relevant in Japanese workplace 飲み会 (nomikai) culture, where pressure to drink can be social or hierarchical.

RELATED WORDS:
- {飲|の}み{会|かい}: company/group drinking party (common context for アルハラ)
- パワハラ: power harassment
- セクハラ: sexual harassment
- アカハラ: academic harassment
